name: Mizu no Senritsu
source:
Shiraishi Hina, a second-year schoolgirl, one day finds strange incidents happening to her, from being pushed down the stairs to having wild dogs attack her. At night, a mysterious elderly woman speaks to her in her dreams.
Hina soon finds herself caught in a war between two supernatural human races.

[Edited from [url=http://forums.theirisnetwork.org/viewtopic.php?t=649]Tekanji[/url]]
